question: What result follows for one devoted to ritual practice?
premises: A person may be devoted to practice.
Such devotion leads to participation in accomplishment.
This outcome is stated as certain.
inference: One devoted to practice certainly becomes a sharer in all accomplishment.
uncertainties: The scope of sarvaṃ as all accomplishments or all things is context-dependent.
plain_english: One devoted to practice would certainly become a sharer in all accomplishment.
